meta.name: competitive-battlecard
meta.description: Create sales-ready competitive battlecards comparing your product against a specific competitor — positioning, feature comparison, objection handling, and win/loss patterns. Use when preparing sales teams, creating competitive materials, or responding to 'why not competitor X?'

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速生成销售对战卡，对比产品与竞品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为销售团队制作竞品对比材料
copy.tagline_en: Generate sales-ready battlecards comparing your product against competitors
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create competitive comparison materials for your sales team

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你制作一份销售用的竞争对战卡，对比你的产品和某个竞争对手，包括定位、功能对比、反对意见处理和赢/输模式。
howto.when: 当你需要准备销售材料、应对“为什么不选竞争对手X”的问题，或者想分析竞争对手时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一份和竞争对手A的对战卡。
say.note: Claude 会搜索竞争对手信息并生成对战卡。

say.text: 分析我们和B公司的优劣势，做成对战卡。
say.note: Claude 会对比功能、定价等并输出表格。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you create a sales-ready competitive battlecard comparing your product against a specific competitor, covering positioning, feature comparison, objection handling, and win/loss patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to prepare sales materials, respond to 'why not competitor X?', or analyze a competitor.

say_en.text: Create a battlecard against Competitor A.
say_en.note: Claude will research and generate the battlecard.

say_en.text: Analyze our strengths vs Company B and make a battlecard.
say_en.note: Claude will compare features, pricing, etc., and output a table.
